rounds.finding: One false alarm in each of two temporal null families; exact upper 0.06624 at n=128, a precision limitation. The final n=512 was already preregistered; no threshold change is made.

rounds.cause: Review found finite complex components whose modulus overflows to infinity, outside the calibration amplitude envelope. Winding must abstain instead of returning zero.
rounds.repair: Exclude nonfinite modulus from valid phase support; preserve all ordinary calibration parameters and seed policy.
rounds.calibration_policy: Rerun the same calibration trials for code-custody verification, not additional independent evidence; keep first output bytes and verification receipt.
